scope: Execute rebuilt display callbacks with injected engine/miniport failures.
tests: Mode/map failures publish nothing; bitmap/association failures release the acquired mapping before PDEV free
Unsupported bitmap format unwinds its mapping
Mapping base distinct from visible base is used for unmap; delete precedes unmap, duplicate enable is rejected and repeated disable is harmless
Failed unmap retains ownership, blocks remap and retries during PDEV teardown; persistent failure does not free its owner
Failed engine deletion never unmaps a live surface or frees its owner; successful retry releases in order
limits: Modeled callbacks with compiled x86 code, not live GDI concurrency or PnP stop/remove qualification. A persistent release error can retain resources until teardown/reboot; no arbitrary forced unmap.
